title: Briefing for 2026-11-06
intro: Good morning. Here is your briefing for 2026-11-06: US markets, global news, and the Philippines, in five minutes.

Bank of England hikes interest rate for the first time since Iran war, warns inflation will near 5%. Voters say the economy drove them to the polls — and blame Trump for their troubles. Analysis: The Democrats have one chance to extract concessions from Trump. Markets will hate it. Euro zone inflation hits 4% for first time in three years as interest rate hike looms.
global: Global tech stocks plunge as US midterms add to AI slowdown fears. Trump signs order preventing future presidents from changing Oval Office. White House denies Hegseth and Rubio to leave jobs after Republican election losses. Pope begins lengthy trip to Latin America weeks after lung cancer surgery. Paraguay President Santiago Peña resigns after bank collapse. French protests see numbers surge as unions join strikes over high cost of living.
philippines: US warns of ‘ongoing cyber threat’ to industrial refrigeration systems. Unemployment edges up to 5.4% in September 2026. [Puso at Diwa] Wanted: Integrity dividend. [Market Rider] Essential market insights on the recent GCash IPO.
outro: That's your briefing. Have a great day.
